recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. FHIR-17202 is satisfied in the current build; any future desire for stronger constraints or new source-of-truth behavior should be handled by a new work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-17202 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core STU3 change request from FHIR-I asking to improve MetadataResource.url guidance so the canonical URL points to an official/authoritative artifact version and does not get changed to a local URL when the artifact is stored on another server.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git-svn commit f07cceebbe1520f616e08ca941d70f4e1774ce41, corresponding to Jira's svn 14456 comment. That commit changed source/metadataresource/metadataresource-spreadsheet.xml to add authoritative-instance language and the rule that the URL remains the same across servers.
additional_context: Current source has moved the shared canonical URL wording to CanonicalResource.url and Definition.url. source/fhir.ini lists canonicalresource and metadataresource as active infrastructure interfaces. FHIR-25568 explains why MetadataResource carries CanonicalResource fields, FHIR-17232 explains the meta.source guidance now present in the URL comment, FHIR-21243 and FHIR-22699 corrected the duplicate 'at which' typo from derived wording, and FHIR-40406 aligned Definition pattern documentation with CanonicalResource without reversing FHIR-17202.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active current source already says the canonical URL SHOULD be globally unique, SHOULD be a literal address at which an authoritative instance is or will be published, can be the target of a canonical reference, and SHALL remain the same when stored on different servers; the comment also points to meta.source for current master-source location.

related_jiras.note: Confirms MetadataResource snapshots should include CanonicalResource fields, supporting CanonicalResource.url as the current source location for the old MetadataResource.url wording.
Adds complementary Resource.meta.source guidance for cases where the current authoritative source changes; the current CanonicalResource.url comment reflects this.
Corrects the duplicate 'at which' typo in Questionnaire.url wording derived from the canonical URL text.
Corrects the same duplicate 'at which' typo for ValueSet.url wording.
Aligns Definition pattern documentation with CanonicalResource while retaining the FHIR-17202 canonical URL semantics.
